narrative.details:
This is a scale shed from a plagued dragon hatchling.  But unlike the other pocked, oozing scales on the infant beast, this rare scale is healthy and unmarred.

Betina Bigglezink will want a sample of this to study.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Healthy Dragon Scale to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
narrative.offerRewardText: Excellent! This will be invaluable in my continued studies of the machinations of the Scourge. Thank you, adventurer, and if you find more of these scales please bring them to me!
narrative.requestItemsText: adventurer, do you have something to show me?
